// SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-only
// Test data: Copyright Grafana Labs contributors.
// Adapted for Pulse on 2026-10-28; the adjacent LICENSE applies.
// Standard-library-only AST/source extraction, following json-parser-producer.go.txt.
// This never executes Loki/Pulse or computes parser/query expectations.
// From the Pulse repository root, using the unmodified pinned Loki checkout:
//
//	cp test/fixtures/logs/loki-upstream/json-expressions-producer.go.txt /tmp/json-expressions-producer.go
//	GO="$HOME/go/pkg/mod/golang.org/toolchain@v0.0.1-go1.27.3.darwin-arm64/bin/go"
//	GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off "$GO" build -o /tmp/json-expressions-producer /tmp/json-expressions-producer.go
//	/tmp/json-expressions-producer /tmp/pulse-loki-expressions-reference > /tmp/json-expressions.json
//	cmp /tmp/json-expressions.json test/fixtures/logs/loki-upstream/json-expressions.json
//
// Normal Elixir/Rust replay reads committed JSON, without Go or network access.
package main

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"go/ast"
	"go/parser"
	"go/token"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"regexp"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

const revision = "5aa4b9212d64d723f63b2770452054aa23df114d"
const parserPath = "pkg/logql/log/parser_test.go"
const grammarPath = "pkg/logql/log/jsonexpr/jsonexpr_test.go"
const enginePath = "pkg/logql/internal/logqltest/testdata/parsers.logqltest"

func must(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
func require(ok bool, message string) {
	if !ok {
		panic(message)
	}
}
func hash(data []byte) string { return fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(data)) }
func number(s string) int     { n, err := strconv.Atoi(s); must(err); return n }
func unquote(s string) string { v, err := strconv.Unquote(s); must(err); return v }
func literal(e ast.Expr) string {
	lit, ok := e.(*ast.BasicLit)
	require(ok && lit.Kind == token.STRING, "expected string literal")
	return unquote(lit.Value)
}
func nilExpr(e ast.Expr) bool { id, ok := e.(*ast.Ident); return ok && id.Name == "nil" }

type selection struct {
	Purpose     string `json:"purpose"`
	SourceStart int    `json:"source_start"`
	SourceEnd   int    `json:"source_end"`
	SHA256      string `json:"sha256"`
	Raw         string `json:"raw"`
}
type source struct {
	Path       string      `json:"path"`
	SHA256     string      `json:"sha256"`
	URL        string      `json:"url"`
	Selections []selection `json:"selections"`
}

func selectLines(data []byte, first, last int, purpose string) selection {
	lines := strings.SplitAfter(string(data), "\n")
	require(first > 0 && last >= first && last <= len(lines), "invalid source range")
	raw := strings.Join(lines[first-1:last], "")
	return selection{purpose, first, last, hash([]byte(raw)), raw}
}
func loadSource(root, path, expectedHash string) ([]byte, source) {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(path)))
	must(err)
	require(hash(data) == expectedHash, "unrecognized source bytes: "+path)
	return data, source{Path: path, SHA256: hash(data), URL: "https://github.com/grafana/loki/blob/" + revision + "/" + path}
}

type goSource struct {
	data []byte
	fset *token.FileSet
	file *ast.File
}

func parseSource(data []byte, path string) goSource {
	fset := token.NewFileSet()
	f, err := parser.ParseFile(fset, path, data, 0)
	must(err)
	return goSource{data, fset, f}
}
func (s goSource) raw(n ast.Node) string {
	return string(s.data[s.fset.Position(n.Pos()).Offset:s.fset.Position(n.End()).Offset])
}
func (s goSource) row(n ast.Node) selection {
	return selectLines(s.data, s.fset.Position(n.Pos()).Line, s.fset.Position(n.End()).Line, "complete original table row")
}
func (s goSource) function(name string, first, last int) *ast.FuncDecl {
	for _, decl := range s.file.Decls {
		if fn, ok := decl.(*ast.FuncDecl); ok && fn.Name.Name == name {
			require(s.fset.Position(fn.Pos()).Line == first && s.fset.Position(fn.End()).Line == last, "unexpected function boundary: "+name)
			return fn
		}
	}
	panic("missing function: " + name)
}
func table(fn *ast.FuncDecl, count int) *ast.CompositeLit {
	for _, stmt := range fn.Body.List {
		if assign, ok := stmt.(*ast.AssignStmt); ok && len(assign.Lhs) == 1 {
			if id, ok := assign.Lhs[0].(*ast.Ident); ok && id.Name == "tests" {
				t := assign.Rhs[0].(*ast.CompositeLit)
				require(len(t.Elts) == count, "unexpected table length")
				return t
			}
		}
	}
	panic("missing tests table")
}
func declaredString(s goSource, name string) string {
	var found *ast.BasicLit
	ast.Inspect(s.file, func(n ast.Node) bool {
		if spec, ok := n.(*ast.ValueSpec); ok {
			for i, id := range spec.Names {
				if id.Name == name {
					require(found == nil, "duplicate constant")
					found = spec.Values[i].(*ast.BasicLit)
				}
			}
		}
		return true
	})
	require(found != nil, "missing constant: "+name)
	return literal(found)
}
func labelString(e ast.Expr, constants map[string]string, s goSource) string {
	if lit, ok := e.(*ast.BasicLit); ok {
		return literal(lit)
	}
	v, ok := constants[s.raw(e)]
	require(ok, "unresolved label constant: "+s.raw(e))
	return v
}
func labels(e ast.Expr, constants map[string]string, s goSource) map[string]string {
	call := e.(*ast.CallExpr)
	selector := call.Fun.(*ast.SelectorExpr)
	require(selector.X.(*ast.Ident).Name == "labels", "unexpected labels package")
	out := map[string]string{}
	if selector.Sel.Name == "EmptyLabels" {
		require(len(call.Args) == 0, "unexpected EmptyLabels arguments")
		return out
	}
	require(selector.Sel.Name == "FromStrings" && len(call.Args)%2 == 0, "unsupported labels expression")
	for i := 0; i < len(call.Args); i += 2 {
		key := labelString(call.Args[i], constants, s)
		_, exists := out[key]
		require(!exists, "duplicate label")
		out[key] = labelString(call.Args[i+1], constants, s)
	}
	return out
}
func metadata(e ast.Expr) map[string]string {
	out := map[string]string{}
	if nilExpr(e) {
		return out
	}
	for _, field := range e.(*ast.CompositeLit).Elts {
		pair := field.(*ast.KeyValueExpr)
		key := literal(pair.Key)
		_, exists := out[key]
		require(!exists, "duplicate metadata")
		out[key] = literal(pair.Value)
	}
	return out
}
func field(e ast.Expr, s goSource) []string {
	call := e.(*ast.CallExpr)
	require(s.raw(call.Fun) == "NewLabelExtractionExpr" && len(call.Args) == 2, "unexpected extraction expression")
	return []string{literal(call.Args[0]), literal(call.Args[1])}
}
func extractExpressions(s goSource, constants map[string]string) []map[string]any {
	fn := s.function("TestJSONExpressionParser", 403, 773)
	lineAssign := fn.Body.List[0].(*ast.AssignStmt)
	require(s.raw(lineAssign.Lhs[0]) == "testLine", "missing shared testLine")
	shared := lineAssign.Rhs[0].(*ast.CallExpr)
	require(s.raw(shared.Fun) == "[]byte" && len(shared.Args) == 1, "unexpected testLine conversion")
	sharedLine := literal(shared.Args[0])
	t := table(fn, 29)
	require(s.fset.Position(t.End()).Line == 758, "unexpected expression table boundary")
	rows := []map[string]any{}
	for _, e := range t.Elts {
		item := e.(*ast.CompositeLit)
		require(len(item.Elts) == 7, "unexpected expression row shape")
		line := sharedLine
		if id, ok := item.Elts[1].(*ast.Ident); ok {
			require(id.Name == "testLine", "unknown shared line")
		} else {
			call := item.Elts[1].(*ast.CallExpr)
			require(s.raw(call.Fun) == "[]byte" && len(call.Args) == 1, "unexpected line conversion")
			line = literal(call.Args[0])
		}
		fields := [][]string{}
		for _, expression := range item.Elts[2].(*ast.CompositeLit).Elts {
			fields = append(fields, field(expression, s))
		}
		hint := s.raw(item.Elts[5])
		require(hint == "NoParserHints()" || hint == `NewParserHint([]string{"__error__"}, nil, false, true, "")`, "unexpected hint")
		sel := s.row(item)
		rows = append(rows, map[string]any{
			"name": literal(item.Elts[0]), "function": fn.Name.Name, "line": line, "line_expression": s.raw(item.Elts[1]),
			"fields": fields, "expressions_expression": s.raw(item.Elts[2]), "base_labels": labels(item.Elts[3], constants, s),
			"want": labels(item.Elts[4], constants, s), "want_expression": s.raw(item.Elts[4]), "hint_expression": hint, "hinted": hint != "NoParserHints()",
			"structured_metadata": metadata(item.Elts[6]), "metadata_expression": s.raw(item.Elts[6]), "initial_parsed_labels": map[string]string{},
			"source_start": sel.SourceStart, "source_end": sel.SourceEnd, "sha256": sel.SHA256, "raw": sel.Raw,
		})
	}
	return rows
}
func extractFailures(s goSource) []map[string]any {
	fn := s.function("TestJSONExpressionParserFailures", 775, 815)
	format := ""
	ast.Inspect(fn, func(n ast.Node) bool {
		if c, ok := n.(*ast.CallExpr); ok && s.raw(c.Fun) == "fmt.Sprintf" {
			require(format == "", "multiple error formats")
			format = literal(c.Args[0])
		}
		return true
	})
	require(format == "cannot parse expression [%s]: syntax error: %s", "unexpected failure assertion format")
	rows := []map[string]any{}
	for _, e := range table(fn, 5).Elts {
		item := e.(*ast.CompositeLit)
		require(len(item.Elts) == 3, "unexpected constructor row shape")
		f, sel := field(item.Elts[1], s), s.row(item)
		rows = append(rows, map[string]any{
			"name": literal(item.Elts[0]), "function": fn.Name.Name, "destination": f[0], "expression": f[1], "fields": [][]string{f},
			"outcome": "reject", "error_suffix": literal(item.Elts[2]), "error": fmt.Sprintf(format, f[1], literal(item.Elts[2])), "error_assertion": "exact", "error_format": format,
			"source_start": sel.SourceStart, "source_end": sel.SourceEnd, "sha256": sel.SHA256, "raw": sel.Raw,
		})
	}
	return rows
}
func extractGrammar(s goSource) []map[string]any {
	fn := s.function("TestJSONExpressionParser", 10, 143)
	t := table(fn, 18)
	require(s.fset.Position(t.End()).Line == 128, "unexpected grammar table boundary")
	rows := []map[string]any{}
	for _, e := range t.Elts {
		item := e.(*ast.CompositeLit)
		require(len(item.Elts) == 4, "unexpected grammar row shape")
		var want []any
		if !nilExpr(item.Elts[2]) {
			want = []any{}
			for _, part := range item.Elts[2].(*ast.CompositeLit).Elts {
				lit := part.(*ast.BasicLit)
				switch lit.Kind {
				case token.STRING:
					want = append(want, literal(lit))
				case token.INT:
					want = append(want, number(lit.Value))
				default:
					panic("unexpected grammar path component")
				}
			}
		}
		var expectedError any
		outcome, assertion := "path", "not_asserted"
		if want == nil {
			outcome = "nil_path"
		}
		if !nilExpr(item.Elts[3]) {
			call := item.Elts[3].(*ast.CallExpr)
			require(s.raw(call.Fun) == "fmt.Errorf" && len(call.Args) == 1, "unexpected grammar error")
			expectedError, outcome, assertion = literal(call.Args[0]), "reject", "exact"
		}
		sel := s.row(item)
		rows = append(rows, map[string]any{
			"name": literal(item.Elts[0]), "function": fn.Name.Name, "expression": literal(item.Elts[1]), "want": want,
			"want_expression": s.raw(item.Elts[2]), "error": expectedError, "error_expression": s.raw(item.Elts[3]), "error_assertion": assertion, "outcome": outcome,
			"source_start": sel.SourceStart, "source_end": sel.SourceEnd, "sha256": sel.SHA256, "raw": sel.Raw,
		})
	}
	return rows
}

type load struct {
	Labels   map[string]string `json:"labels"`
	Line     string            `json:"line"`
	Start    int               `json:"start"`
	Every    int               `json:"every"`
	Count    int               `json:"count"`
	Metadata map[string]string `json:"metadata"`
	selection
}
type series struct {
	Labels map[string]string `json:"labels"`
	Values []string          `json:"values"`
	selection
}
type engineCase struct {
	Query           string   `json:"query"`
	ParserForm      string   `json:"parser_form"`
	Mode            string   `json:"mode"`
	Start           int      `json:"start"`
	End             int      `json:"end"`
	Step            int      `json:"step"`
	Outcome         string   `json:"outcome"`
	Reject          string   `json:"reject,omitempty"`
	Expected        []series `json:"expected"`
	ExpectedEntries []any    `json:"expected_entries"`
	selection
}
type fixture struct {
	Loads []load       `json:"loads"`
	Cases []engineCase `json:"cases"`
	selection
}

var goString = "(?:\"(?:[^\"\\\\]|\\\\.)*\"|`[^`]*`)"
var labelPair = regexp.MustCompile(`^([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)=(` + goString + `)`)

func labelText(text string) map[string]string {
	out := map[string]string{}
	for text = strings.TrimSpace(text); text != ""; text = strings.TrimSpace(text) {
		m := labelPair.FindStringSubmatch(text)
		require(m != nil, "unexpected label text: "+text)
		_, exists := out[m[1]]
		require(!exists, "duplicate label text")
		out[m[1]] = unquote(m[2])
		text = strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(text[len(m[0]):], ","))
	}
	return out
}
func engineLine(quoted string) string {
	require(len(quoted) >= 2 && quoted[0] == quoted[len(quoted)-1] && (quoted[0] == '`' || quoted[0] == '"'), "invalid engine line")
	line := quoted[1 : len(quoted)-1]
	require(!strings.ContainsRune(line, rune(quoted[0])), "embedded engine quote unsupported")
	return line
}
func stripComment(line string) string {
	var quote byte
	for i := 0; i < len(line); i++ {
		c := line[i]
		switch {
		case quote != 0:
			if c == quote {
				quote = 0
			}
		case c == '"' || c == '`':
			quote = c
		case c == '#':
			return strings.TrimRight(line[:i], " \t")
		}
	}
	return line
}
func extractEngine(data []byte) []fixture {
	lines := strings.Split(string(data), "\n")
	require(lines[282] == "# json() with label expressions:" && lines[303] == "# regexp()", "unexpected engine block boundary")
	loadRE := regexp.MustCompile(`^\{([^}]*)\}\s+(` + goString + `)\s+@ (\d+)s(?: \[repeat every (\d+)s for (\d+)\])?(?: \[metadata (.*)\])?$`)
	instantRE := regexp.MustCompile(`^eval instant at (\d+)s (.+)$`)
	rangeRE := regexp.MustCompile(`^eval range from (\d+)s to (\d+)s step (\d+)s (.+)$`)
	resultRE := regexp.MustCompile(`^\{([^}]*)\}\s+([\d_ ]+)$`)
	current := fixture{Loads: []load{}, Cases: []engineCase{}, selection: selection{SourceStart: 288}}
	var evaluation *engineCase
	finish := func() {
		if evaluation == nil {
			return
		}
		if evaluation.Outcome == "reject" {
			require(evaluation.Reject != "" && len(evaluation.Expected) == 0, "contradictory rejection")
		} else {
			require(evaluation.Outcome == "series" && len(evaluation.Expected) > 0, "missing metric oracle")
			points := 1
			if evaluation.Mode == "range" {
				require(evaluation.Step > 0 && (evaluation.End-evaluation.Start)%evaluation.Step == 0, "invalid range geometry")
				points += (evaluation.End - evaluation.Start) / evaluation.Step
			}
			for _, expected := range evaluation.Expected {
				require(len(expected.Values) == points, "incorrect expected point count")
			}
		}
		evaluation.selection = selectLines(data, evaluation.SourceStart, evaluation.SourceEnd, "complete evaluation and exact oracle")
		current.Cases = append(current.Cases, *evaluation)
		current.SourceEnd = evaluation.SourceEnd
		evaluation = nil
	}
	for lineNo := 283; lineNo <= 303; lineNo++ {
		text := strings.TrimSpace(stripComment(lines[lineNo-1]))
		if text == "" {
			continue
		}
		switch {
		case text == "clear":
			require(lineNo == 288, "unexpected clear")
		case text == "load":
			require(lineNo == 289, "unexpected load")
		case strings.HasPrefix(text, "eval "):
			finish()
			require(len(current.Loads) == 2, "missing loads")
			evaluation = &engineCase{ParserForm: "explicit_paths", Outcome: "series", Expected: []series{}, ExpectedEntries: []any{}, selection: selection{SourceStart: lineNo, SourceEnd: lineNo}}
			if m := instantRE.FindStringSubmatch(text); m != nil {
				evaluation.Mode, evaluation.Start, evaluation.End, evaluation.Query = "instant", number(m[1]), number(m[1]), m[2]
			} else if m := rangeRE.FindStringSubmatch(text); m != nil {
				evaluation.Mode, evaluation.Start, evaluation.End, evaluation.Step, evaluation.Query = "range", number(m[1]), number(m[2]), number(m[3]), m[4]
			} else {
				panic("unexpected evaluation: " + text)
			}
			require(strings.Contains(evaluation.Query, "| json "), "unexpected parser form")
		case evaluation != nil:
			require(evaluation.Outcome != "reject", "expectation after rejection")
			evaluation.SourceEnd = lineNo
			if strings.HasPrefix(text, "expect fail msg: ") {
				evaluation.Outcome, evaluation.Reject = "reject", strings.TrimPrefix(text, "expect fail msg: ")
			} else {
				m := resultRE.FindStringSubmatch(text)
				require(m != nil, "unexpected metric oracle: "+text)
				evaluation.Expected = append(evaluation.Expected, series{labelText(m[1]), strings.Fields(m[2]), selectLines(data, lineNo, lineNo, "exact combined metric label/value oracle")})
			}
		default:
			m := loadRE.FindStringSubmatch(text)
			require(m != nil, "unexpected load: "+text)
			row := load{Labels: labelText(m[1]), Line: engineLine(m[2]), Start: number(m[3]), Count: 1, Metadata: labelText(m[6]), selection: selectLines(data, lineNo, lineNo, "complete load row")}
			if m[4] != "" {
				row.Every, row.Count = number(m[4]), number(m[5])
			}
			current.Loads = append(current.Loads, row)
		}
	}
	finish()
	require(current.SourceEnd == 302 && len(current.Cases) == 5, "incomplete engine fixture")
	current.selection = selectLines(data, current.SourceStart, current.SourceEnd, "complete clear/load/evaluation fixture")
	return []fixture{current}
}

func main() {
	require(len(os.Args) == 2, "usage: json-expressions-producer /path/to/pinned/loki")
	root := os.Args[1]
	parserData, parserSource := loadSource(root, parserPath, "346b91ced2d38e51d8cf7fd8acb3335ea5796e9286fd901b45dd625c0b3634ff")
	grammarData, grammarSource := loadSource(root, grammarPath, "e2e4ded6592d2f8a7d44301db7696e48fcd91da7d2ef26aade94c62fad73b4d0")
	engineData, engineSource := loadSource(root, enginePath, "07d63941842085ca40bbc3944884377e802df38ede67027b9702594e840114ea")
	errorData, errorSource := loadSource(root, "pkg/logql/log/error.go", "d836fe896703aaa92d53baa61e6532c605344261460af3bab3994d531fa14458")
	modelData, modelSource := loadSource(root, "pkg/logqlmodel/error.go", "21816c4294243f16157f6408d92fb0907612a3258333288ab39b3f84bf7a4db5")
	harnessData, harnessSource := loadSource(root, "pkg/logql/internal/logqltest/parser.go", "9e39b25a51dd254d9e2ac2517558bcd172d652844043c34c116abaa10dc3b239")
	parserSource.Selections = []selection{
		selectLines(parserData, 403, 758, "complete TestJSONExpressionParser declaration, shared testLine, schema and all 29 ordered rows"),
		selectLines(parserData, 759, 773, "inert harness provenance: constructor success, hints, metadata and flat label assertions"),
		selectLines(parserData, 775, 806, "complete TestJSONExpressionParserFailures declaration, schema and all five rows"),
		selectLines(parserData, 807, 815, "constructor-failure exact error assertion and original formatting template"),
	}
	grammarSource.Selections = []selection{
		selectLines(grammarData, 10, 128, "complete TestJSONExpressionParser grammar declaration, schema and all 18 rows"),
		selectLines(grammarData, 129, 143, "inert grammar harness provenance: path equality for all rows; errors checked only when nonnil"),
	}
	engineSource.Selections = []selection{selectLines(engineData, 283, 303, "complete explicit-JSON engine block through the separator before regexp at 304")}
	errorSource.Selections = []selection{selectLines(errorData, 11, 11, "source of errJSON used in two expression-table expected labels")}
	modelSource.Selections = []selection{selectLines(modelData, 27, 27, "source of logqlmodel.ErrorLabel used in two expression-table expected labels")}
	harnessSource.Selections = []selection{
		selectLines(harnessData, 19, 25, "inert engine epoch provenance"),
		selectLines(harnessData, 129, 135, "inert repeat count, ordering, timestamp and metadata provenance"),
		selectLines(harnessData, 162, 178, "inert engine log-string delimiter/no-unescaping provenance"),
		selectLines(harnessData, 428, 451, "inert engine rejection message-substring provenance"),
		selectLines(harnessData, 732, 749, "inert quote-aware inline-comment provenance"),
	}
	s := parseSource(parserData, parserPath)
	constants := map[string]string{"errJSON": declaredString(parseSource(errorData, errorSource.Path), "errJSON"), "logqlmodel.ErrorLabel": declaredString(parseSource(modelData, modelSource.Path), "ErrorLabel")}
	expressions, failures, grammar, fixtures := extractExpressions(s, constants), extractFailures(s), extractGrammar(parseSource(grammarData, grammarPath)), extractEngine(engineData)
	counts := map[string]int{
		"expression_rows": len(expressions), "constructor_failure_rows": len(failures), "grammar_rows": len(grammar), "engine_fixtures": len(fixtures),
		"table_hinted_rows": 0, "table_unhinted_rows": 0, "table_metadata_rows": 0, "table_ordered_expressions": 0,
		"grammar_path_rows": 0, "grammar_nil_path_rows": 0, "grammar_reject_rows": 0,
		"engine_metadata_load_rows": 0, "engine_select_evaluations": 0, "engine_empty_evaluations": 0, "engine_expected_entries": 0,
	}
	for _, row := range expressions {
		if row["hinted"].(bool) {
			counts["table_hinted_rows"]++
		} else {
			counts["table_unhinted_rows"]++
		}
		if len(row["structured_metadata"].(map[string]string)) > 0 {
			counts["table_metadata_rows"]++
		}
		counts["table_ordered_expressions"] += len(row["fields"].([][]string))
	}
	for _, row := range grammar {
		counts["grammar_"+row["outcome"].(string)+"_rows"]++
	}
	for _, fixture := range fixtures {
		counts["engine_load_rows"] += len(fixture.Loads)
		for _, load := range fixture.Loads {
			counts["engine_loaded_entries"] += load.Count
			if len(load.Metadata) > 0 {
				counts["engine_metadata_load_rows"]++
			}
		}
		for _, row := range fixture.Cases {
			counts["engine_evaluations"]++
			counts["engine_"+row.Mode+"_evaluations"]++
			counts["engine_"+row.Outcome+"_evaluations"]++
			counts["engine_expected_series"] += len(row.Expected)
			for _, series := range row.Expected {
				for _, value := range series.Values {
					if value == "_" {
						counts["engine_sparse_slots"]++
					} else {
						counts["engine_numeric_slots"]++
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	counts["total_source_rows_and_evaluations"] = len(expressions) + len(failures) + len(grammar) + counts["engine_evaluations"]
	for key, want := range map[string]int{
		"expression_rows": 29, "table_ordered_expressions": 30, "table_hinted_rows": 1, "table_unhinted_rows": 28, "table_metadata_rows": 1,
		"constructor_failure_rows": 5, "grammar_rows": 18, "grammar_path_rows": 11, "grammar_nil_path_rows": 1, "grammar_reject_rows": 6,
		"engine_fixtures": 1, "engine_load_rows": 2, "engine_loaded_entries": 8, "engine_metadata_load_rows": 0,
		"engine_evaluations": 5, "engine_instant_evaluations": 3, "engine_range_evaluations": 2, "engine_series_evaluations": 4, "engine_reject_evaluations": 1,
		"engine_expected_series": 4, "engine_expected_entries": 0, "engine_numeric_slots": 6, "engine_sparse_slots": 1, "total_source_rows_and_evaluations": 57,
	} {
		require(counts[key] == want, fmt.Sprintf("incorrect count %s: got %d, want %d", key, counts[key], want))
	}
	artifact := map[string]any{
		"schema_version": 1, "revision": revision, "license": "AGPL-3.0-only",

			"sources":               []source{parserSource, grammarSource, engineSource, errorSource, modelSource, harnessSource},

		},
